```{r setup}
library(linregPackage)
library(linregPackage)
library(mlbench)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)

data("BostonHousing")

set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(BostonHousing$medv, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- BostonHousing[train_index, ]
test_data  <- BostonHousing[-train_index, ]

# 1. Standard Linear Model (lm)
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)

model_lm <- train(medv ~ ., data = train_data, method = "lm", trControl = ctrl)

# 2. Custom Ridge Regression Model
# Define a custom caret model list for ridgereg if required, or fit directly:
# For simplicity, we can evaluate test RMSE directly using our ridgereg function:
lambda_grid <- c(0, 1, 5, 10, 50, 100)
best_rmse <- Inf
best_lambda <- 0
best_model <- NULL

for (lam in lambda_grid) {
  fit <- ridgereg(medv ~ ., data = train_data, lambda = lam)
  # Predict on test set
  # Create model frame for test data
  tt <- delete.response(terms(medv ~ ., data = train_data))
  mf_test <- model.frame(tt, test_data)
  X_test <- model.matrix(tt, mf_test)
  preds <- as.vector(X_test %*% fit$coefficients)
  
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_data$medv - preds)^2))
  if (rmse < best_rmse) {
    best_rmse <- rmse
    best_lambda <- lam
    best_model <- fit
  }
}

cat("Best Lambda found via grid search:", best_lambda, "\n")
cat("Best Ridge Test RMSE:", best_rmse, "\n")
```
